svg.text: Compute & Context Anatomy · Unit Rate × Multi-Turn Tool Loops = 8-Task Spend
Why Agentic Over-Polishing Multiplies Context Volume from 0.8M to 21.5M Tokens
Models sorted by total 8-task AI credits (auto at 9.1 cr to claude-opus-5 at 1,475 cr). Panel B shows total tokens + visual view() calls; Panel C stacks credits by task.
C. Total 8-Task AI Credits Stack (1 cr = $0.01)
Note: (Nt/Mv) in Panel B shows total tool calls (t) and visual view() calls (v) across 8 tasks. Red bars highlight models exceeding 9M cumulative input+output tokens.
